text: In the unprecedented low interest rate environment prevailing since 2005, investment managers responded to retail investors reaching for yield by offering unconstrained mutual funds, a product that authorizes absolute return strategies in the fixed income world.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
